title: What does a transported hazard ratio summarize under non-proportional hazards, and how do the recommended replacements behave?
question: When hazards are not proportional, what quantity does a population-adjusted hazard ratio estimate, and do the recommended replacements (RMST, milestone survival, flexible ML-NMR) recover their own estimands when transported?
design: Registered after six rounds of pre-run critique, with every quoted number generated from the code and checked by script. The registered run has started and is paused while the shared machine is overloaded.
